We enable our customers to radically innovate, drastically reduce costs, and efficiently address the business imperatives of the evolving healthcare economy. jobs.description:
Overview:

**Job Title:** Senior Business Analyst

**Work Location:** Hyderabad, India (Hybrid Mode)

**Job Description**

**Summary**

Senior Business Analysts will be responsible for leading and implementing technical solutions to business problems, or to advance a company’s efforts, begins with defining, analysing and documenting requirements. This role shall also be managing internal and external stakeholders and expectations. Managing requirements at the project level can help fulfil business needs. To succeed in this role, you should have a natural analytical way of thinking, a broad picture of the problem statement, its impact and its user space and a good understanding of our internal and external stakeholders and drive towards the best successful outcome for both.

To be successful in this role you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and ability.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Manage and collaborate with client stakeholders
* Manage and collaborate with internal stakeholders
* Understand business and technical need of the requirements.
* Capture the requirements and prioritize them along with the respective stakeholders.
* Break the requirements into smaller tasks or stories based on necessity.
* Prepare the requirement traceability matrix and maintain it.
* Create user story documents with reference to the traceability matrix created.
* Capture the acceptance for all the requirements.
* Work on gap analysis between two versions of guiding Care for client upgrades.
* First point of contact for all the requirement related clarifications.
* Validate all the requirements with respect to the story documentation signed off by the stakeholders.
* Demonstrate features and help the stakeholders to stay abreast with the features of the product.
* Participate in daily scrums, sprint planning meetings, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Participate in daily meetings with product managers, SMEs, and other stakeholders extracting requirements.
* Work as a liaison between the stakeholders/clients and scrum team.
* Analyse customer workflows and convert them into system workflows.
* Communicates status externally and raising risk at the right time.
* Support new client implementations.
* Manage Product Backlog.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

Senior Business Analyst is not a supervisory role. You will receive general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments.

**Education Qualification**

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Administration

4-7 years of related experience.

Certification - ECBA, CCBA, CBDA, AHM-250 and CBAP is preferred.

**Competencies**

* Agile Business Analysis
* Excellent communicator with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Highly proficient technical writing capabilities
* Presentation skills
* Technical Knowledge
* Analytical Skills
* Negotiation Skills

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon’s Shipment Technologies (STS) team is responsible for key technology that enables planning, orchestration, and execution of transportation service to deliver billions of packages to Amazon.com customer globally. Our goal is to ensure the best delivery experience for customers across all geographies through a highly scalable, adaptive, and autonomous transportation network.  
  
We are looking for a product leader to own our global transportation visibility and intelligence products. They will own critical Amazon services that aggregate real-time data from our transportation network combined with predictive supply chain data to drive automation, efficiency, and visibility. These services allow us to identify problems that could impact on-time delivery, take proactive actions to mitigate network and package level problems, and keep customers informed on what is happening.  
  
The ideal candidate is capable of breaking down and solving complex problems, and has a strong will to get things done! You will work on real world problems on a global scale. You own your products end-to-end and influence the direction of our product and technology which impacts hundreds-of-millions of customers around the world. You are a hands-on, pragmatic problem solver that easily balances trade-offs between competing interests. You thrive in a fast-moving team environment where you are able to juggle complex dependencies and requirements while producing optimal solutions.

Serve as the subject matter expert in transportation visibility and intelligence, leveraging your deep domain knowledge to identify market trends, customer pain points, and opportunities for product enhancement  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and customer success, to translate business requirements into technical specifications and drive the successful implementation of new product features and enhancements  
Develop a comprehensive product roadmap that aligns with the company's overall strategic objectives and effectively communicates it to stakeholders  
Continuously gather and analyze customer feedback, market intelligence, and industry insights to inform product decisions and ensure the delivery of high-value solutions  
Champion a customer-centric design approach, working closely with Operational, Business, and UX team to optimize the user experience and drive product adoption  
Manage the product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring that milestones are met, risks are mitigated, and the product is delivered on time and within budget

* Experience owning technology products

jobs.title: Sr Staff Inbound Product Manager - Partner Relationship Management(PRM)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**The Team**

Partner Relationship Management (PRM) is one of the newest products inside ServiceNow’s Sales CRM organization, built to help companies run their entire partner ecosystem, from deal registration through MDF to partner facing commerce, natively on the Now Platform. The product is just over a year old. This is a genuine zero to one opportunity: the foundational architecture exists, the first design partners are live, and the roadmap for the next phase is still being written by the people building it today.

**What You Get to Do in This Role**

* Own product strategy and roadmap for a defined slice of PRM, from discovery through launch and adoption
* Work directly with design partner customers to validate problems before committing engineering investment, and translate their feedback into clear, buildable requirements
* Partner with engineering scrum teams in India day to day to break down epics, sequence releases, and make tradeoffs under real delivery constraints
* Define and document detailed specs, acceptance criteria, and data models for complex partner ecosystem workflows (partner hierarchies, deal registration, approvals, MDF, catalog driven quoting)
* Collaborate with design and research to shape partner facing and internal facing experiences, from early concepts through usability validation
* Represent PRM in cross functional forums across GTM, design, research, and other stakeholder groups, and build consensus on shared priorities
* Contribute to competitive positioning and help the team understand how PRM should be differentiated against established players in the partner management space
* Mentor and influence product thinking across the broader team, given the staff level scope of this role

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 12+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product area end to end in a B2B SaaS environment
* Experience building or scaling products in the partner ecosystem, channel, or partner relationship management space
* Strong technical fluency, comfortable going deep with engineering on data models, workflow logic, and system architecture
* Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity and build structure where none exists, this is a zero to one environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing stakeholders across geographies and time zones
* Comfortable working with distributed, India based engineering and global product peers across North America

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience with partner relationship management, channel management, or partner ecosystem platforms such as Impartner, PartnerStack, ZINFI, Salesforce Partner Cloud/Community Cloud, SAP, Oracle, or Conga/Apttus
* Experience with CRM, CPQ, quote to cash, or order management systems
* Experience partnering with researchers and designers in a product trio model
* Prior experience at a company with a strong platform or ecosystem play

Snaphomz is an AI-first PropTech platform helping people discover, evaluate, and navigate real estate decisions in the United States. We combine AI, data, and practical tools to make the homebuying experience more transparent and accessible.

**The Opportunity**

· Research U.S. homebuyer pain points, social conversations, creator trends, emerging formats, competitor positioning, and regional opportunities; translate insights into weekly campaign ideas.

· Build an experimentation backlog; define hypotheses, target audiences, success criteria, owners, budgets, and deadlines for each test.

· 2–5 years in growth, digital, or performance marketing, with evidence of campaigns you personally drove and their measurable outcomes.  
· Practical knowledge of U.S. consumer audiences, social trends, messaging, and channel dynamics; ability to research local market differences.  
· Hands-on competence in Meta/Google advertising, SEO/content distribution, email automation, analytics, attribution, and conversion-rate optimization.  
· Working familiarity with GA4, Search Console, Tag Manager, ad managers, CRM/email platforms, and reporting dashboards.  
· A strong creative instinct paired with analytical rigor: you can pitch unconventional ideas and validate them with disciplined experiments.  
· Excellent English communication, cross-functional coordination, prioritization, and the confidence to challenge weak ideas with evidence.  
· High ownership, speed, curiosity, resilience, and willingness to execute personally in a fast-moving startup.

**Nice to Have**  
· Experience in U.S. real estate, PropTech, consumer technology, SaaS, or marketplaces.  
· Track record of creator/influencer partnerships, viral campaigns, referral growth, and community-led acquisition.  
· Experience guiding a small marketing team or coordinating agencies and freelancers.  
· Knowledge of AI-powered marketing workflows and U.S. housing advertising compliance.

**How Success Will Be Measured**  
· Growth in qualified U.S. sign-ups, activated users, leads, and attributable conversions.  
· Sustainable organic search and social growth, with measurable contribution to acquisition.  
· Paid campaign efficiency: qualified lead cost, acquisition cost, conversion rate, and budget discipline.  
· Email-driven engagement, activation, reactivation, and conversions.  
· Speed and quality of experiments launched, learnings applied, and team delivery against agreed priorities.

**Compensation and Performance Bonus**

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. **Primary Responsibilities**

* Define long and short term product/portfolio strategies, identify market needs, define product performance indicators, managing build, launch and operational financials, whilst overseeing all stages of the product lifecycle (Ideate, Define, Build, Launch, Manage, Sunset) to ensure product delivery by ensuring that solutions are defined with high-value requirements, compelling business cases, clear product positioning, and a clear priority order

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Degree or higher in a in a Business, Healthcare, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or equivalent practical experience
* 10+ years of total experience with 5+ years in Product Management
* Experience presenting to senior stakeholders and customers and collaborating with multi-functional teams ensuring the communication and tracking of cross-functional team dependencies
* Experience in product strategy or business development either in a strategy organization or new business
* Experience working within an Agile software development practices and methodologies
* Experience collaboratively with cross functional teams business SMEs, engineers, data scientists and analysts

jobs.title: Product Manager, Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Product Manager, Specialist role is responsible for leading digital product management initiatives, overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of strategic products. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance customer experience, define product roadmaps, and drive business growth. The specialist ensures smooth product execution, manages escalations, and employs data-driven insights to refine product strategies. Additionally, they work with stakeholders to align product goals with business objectives and market needs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead digital product management efforts for multiple digital products or one strategic product, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices that enhance the customer experience and drive impactful changes.
* Coach digital product teams on best practices, learnings, and product development methodologies to maximize efficiency.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues promptly, supporting escalations when needed to enable rapid delivery.
* Oversee the planning, development, and execution of new digital products, including market analysis, feature definition, and implementation planning.
* Develop pricing and positioning strategies, ensuring products are competitive and aligned with market demand.
* Utilize qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience and optimize product performance.
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure timely and resource-efficient delivery.
* Lead product launches by working closely with marketing teams, executives, and other product management stakeholders to drive successful go-to-market strategies.
* Evaluate promotional plans to ensure consistency with product line strategies and effective messaging across customer segments.
* Participate in ongoing business planning, departmental prioritization activities, and special projects as required.
* Own and advance the product roadmap in a fast-paced digital environment, partnering closely with IT teams and applying Agile delivery practices, including day-to-day use of Jira.
* Collaborate across business and technology stakeholders to deliver products that support internal teams and external clients, balancing multiple priorities and translating product strategy into measurable outcomes.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of related work experience, with at least two years of experience leading large cross-functional teams on major organizational projects.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA).
* Strong expertise in digital product management, market analysis, and user experience optimization.
* Proven ability to translate customer insights into product improvements and new features.
* Experience working with engineering teams to drive product development from concept to launch.
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities to align product strategy with business goals.
* Hands-on experience partnering with IT teams in an Agile product delivery environment, including practical experience using Jira to manage product work and priorities.
* Strong digital product management and business acumen; B2B or banking experience is preferred but not mandatory, with the ability to quickly learn the business and technology landscape.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

jobs.description:
**Principal Product Manager - HR Technology & Platforms | Hyderabad | Hybrid**

**Summary**

Cornerstone OnDemand is seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead the delivery of AI-native products and enterprise outcome agents that drive measurable customer value.

This is a customer-facing AI-native product management role for a hands-on PM who can move quickly from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes, using modern AI-native product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co-Pilot and similar platforms. The role requires close collaboration with customers, FDEs, engineering, and cross-functional teams to validate solutions early, iterate rapidly, and launch outcome agents that solve meaningful business problems.

The ideal candidate is highly execution-oriented, comfortable working in ambiguity, and able to translate customer needs into prototypes, product direction, and shipped capabilities with speed and rigor.

**In This Role You Will**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of AI-native products and enterprise outcome agents, from customer discovery and requirements gathering through prototype creation, iteration, and launch.
* Partner directly with customers to understand business problems, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes.
* Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, use cases, and solution concepts that can quickly be tested and refined.
* Build and evolve working prototypes using AI-native tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co-Pilot and similar rapid prototyping platforms to accelerate validation and shorten the path from idea to delivery.
* Turn customer specific outcome agents into re-sellable out-of-the box agents
* Use prototypes as the new PRD motion: move from customer discovery to working AI Agent prototypes that customers, FDE’s and engineering can review, test, and refine.
* Collaborate closely with FDEs and engineering to iterate on prototypes, validate feasibility, refine user flows, and prepare solutions for launch.
* Work with customers, FDEs and engineering in tight feedback loops to improve prototypes, confirm value, and shape deliverable product capabilities.
* Drive cross-functional execution across product, engineering, design, data science, architecture, and go-to-market teams to bring validated concepts into production.
* Ensure launched outcome agents are practical, scalable, and easy for enterprise customers to adopt.
* Use customer feedback, adoption signals, and business-impact metrics to continuously improve product execution and outcomes.

**You Have Got What it Takes if you Have**

* 5+ years of experience in product management, including significant experience delivering enterprise software, SaaS, AI, or platform products.
* Strong track record in customer-facing product delivery for enterprise SaaS or AI-native products.
* Demonstrated ability to go from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes and launched solutions.
* Hands-on experience using AI-native prototyping and product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co-Pilot or similar tools to accelerate product definition and validation.
* Experience collaborating closely with customers and technical delivery partners such as FDEs to iterate rapidly and launch customer-ready solutions.
* Strong product execution skills, including prioritization, prototype validation, release planning, cross-functional coordination, and delivery tracking.
* Experience translating ambiguous customer problems into structured product requirements and testable product experiences.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, matrixed environments and drive alignment across technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow agents, or decision-support products.
* Experience in enterprise AI, workforce technology, learning, talent, HR technology, or related SaaS domains.
* Demonstrated success using rapid prototyping to accelerate product-market fit and customer adoption.
* Experience working in close partnership with customer success, services, sales, and solution delivery teams.

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Product Manager Flick Tools**

**Company:** Flick Network  
**Location:** Remote, India  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About Flick Network

Flick Network is a technology company operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Malaysia, Nigeria and other markets. We are an accredited Peppol Access Point, helping businesses comply with government e-invoicing mandates by connecting enterprise ERP systems to national e-invoicing networks.

We are now building **Flick Tools**, a simple, all-in-one business management product for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). The platform will bring quotations, invoicing, billing, payments, customer management and basic accounting together, with e-invoicing compliance built in.

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own Flick Tools end to end. You will understand SMB customer needs, research the market, define the product roadmap and translate business requirements into clear product specifications.

Working closely with the founders, design and engineering teams, you will shape a product that small businesses find easy to use and are willing to pay for.

This is a product ownership role, not just a coordination role.

Key Responsibilities

* Define and own the product vision, roadmap and feature priorities.
* Conduct customer interviews and market research with SMB owners, accountants and bookkeepers.
* Analyse competitors such as Zoho Invoice, QuickBooks, Xero, Tally and other relevant products.
* Prepare Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with design and engineering teams to develop intuitive user experiences and deliver product features.
* Improve customer onboarding, self-service signup, activation and conversion.

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

This is primarily an operations management role with responsibility for improving existing processes and building new capabilities. You will take ownership of a function, manage its day-to-day operations, improve performance, and implement product and process enhancements. As Ascend Capital grows, you will also have opportunities to establish and lead new functions.

  

**What Youll Do**

* Translate priorities into execution plans (owners, timelines, dependencies) and run follow-ups until closure.
* Map and improve operational workflows across key journeys: onboarding, credit approval, documentation, disbursement, servicing, and collections/support handoffs.
* Identify bottlenecks and repeated errors; run root-cause analysis and implement practical fixes that reduce delays and rework.
* Build and maintain SOPs, checklists, and templates; drive adoption so teams actually use them consistently on the ground.
* Build simple dashboards/MIS for operational metrics (TAT, drop-offs, approval rates, exceptions, customer issues) and surface actions for stakeholders.
* Work closely with ops, credit/risk, tech, sales, customer support, and collections to unblock execution.
* Gather and synthesize customer feedback and internal signals; convert themes into measurable improvement initiatives.
* Track operational risks (process gaps, compliance misses, dependency risks) and drive mitigation plans with clear owners and timelines.
* Improve workflows by identifying the causes of recurring delays, errors and rework, then implementing practical fixes.
* Write product requirement documents (PRDs) that define workflows, requirements and expected outcomes for new processes, products or system changes.

  

**Requirements**

* 0-3 years experience in operations, product/tech support, consulting, fintech/NBFC, program execution, or a high-ownership startup role.
* Strong analytical reasoning: can use data + qualitative signals to diagnose root causes and recommend fixes.
* High ownership and bias for action; comfortable with ambiguity and driving closure.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfortable building basic MIS, trackers, and simple dashboards. (Bonus: SQL/BI familiarity.)
* Show a willingness to learn unfamiliar areas of the business and apply feedback.
* Clear communicator: can write crisp updates, run follow-ups, and align cross-functional teams.
* Customer-first mindset: cares about reducing customer friction and improving reliability of journeys.

  

**About Ascend Capital**

Ascend Capital is a leader in commercial EV finance in India, and we are building the largest company in the category. We are an RBI-registered, profitable NBFC headquartered in Jaipur with a book of around Rs 300 crore, backed by leading venture investors and growing faster than anyone in our segment.

We finance commercial EVs through a network present across multiple states in north and central India. Founded by IIT/IIM alumni with backgrounds at global banks, Ascend combines the discipline of a large financial institution with the speed and ambition of a company still in its early years.

This is a fast-moving, execution-heavy company. The work is on the ground and it is demanding, and people here are trusted with real responsibility early. We are growing quickly, new branches and territories open every quarter, and the people who lead them come from inside the company.

We are looking for people who learn fast, work hard, adapt quickly, take ownership of their numbers and want to build something. If that describes you, we want to talk to you.

  

**Why Join Us**

* Learn how a financial institution is built and run, end to end, rather than seeing only one part of the business.
* Report directly to the Founder and work closely with the leadership team.
* Contribute to our ambition to build Indias largest EV financing company.
* Access opportunities for faster career progression as the company scales and creates new roles.

  

**How to Apply**

Share your updated CV at jobs@ascendcap.in with subject: Product Ops Jaipur. In the email body, add 2–3 lines on:

  

* One messy execution problem you solved (what happened, what you did, what improved).
* Something you took ownership of without being asked.
* One metric/process you improved (even a small one) and how you measured it.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Senior Data Analyst

**Department**: Data Analytics

**Location**: Skyla Corporate Office, Hyderabad

**Role Summary**

The Senior Data Analyst will lead Skyla’s data ecosystem—owning data collection structures, dashboard development, automations, and analytics workflows across departments. This role ensures that the right data is captured, transformed, and delivered to decision-makers with clarity, accuracy, and speed. The analyst will work closely with Sales, Front Office, Finance, Procurement, Marketing, and Operations teams to build scalable reporting systems and continuously improve Skyla’s data-driven culture.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Data Infrastructure & System Ownership

* Own and manage all central data sheets (Sales, Front Office, F&B, Procurement, HR, Google Reviews, etc.).
* Design structured datasets and master tables for reliable reporting**.**
* Implement data governance principles – accuracy checks, validation rules, and controlled access.
* Maintain and update KPI tracking frameworks, data point mappings, and automation scoring sheets.

2. Dashboard Development & Reporting

Build, enhance, and maintain Looker Studio dashboards for:

* Sales Performance
* F&B Revenue & Menu Analytics
* Front Office Metrics
* Procurement Metrics
* Google Reviews & CX Analytics
* Operational KPIs
* Create user-friendly dashboards with filters, drill downs, and automated refresh cycles.
* Standardise report formats and build reusable templates for all teams.

3. Automation & Process Improvement

* Develop and maintain automations (Google Apps Script, formulas, workflow logic). Automate recurring reports such as:
* Consolidated Guest List (PMS)
* Detailed Revenue Report (DRR)
* Cross-department data pulls
* Identify manual processes in any department and convert them into semi/fully automated solutions.
* Build alert systems, cleanup scripts, timestamp automations, and reconciliation tools.

4. Cross-Department Collaboration

* Work directly with Sales, FO, Engineering, Branding, Finance, Procurement, HR & Operations teams to understand data needs.
* Guide teams on how to submit correct data, maintain hygiene, and use standardised formats.
* Translate business questions into analytical solutions.
* Support leadership in performance tracking, forecasting, and strategy execution.

5. Insight Generation & Decision Support

* Conduct trend analysis, variance analysis, and performance deep dives.
* Build storytelling presentations for leadership reviews.
* Identify opportunities for process optimisation, revenue growth, and efficiency improvement using data.
* Provide ad-hoc analytical support for pilots, experiments, and new initiatives.

6. Quality Control & Data Hygiene

* Regularly audit data for gaps, duplication, or inconsistencies.
* Implement validation logic across sheets to prevent data entry errors.
* Ensure all dashboards reflect real-time, accurate data.

**Skills & Competencies Required**

Technical Skills

* Advanced Google Sheets (ARRAY FORMULA, QUERY, INDEX-MATCH, REGEX, IMPORTRANGE, pivot tables).
* Google Looker Studio dashboard building.
* Google Apps Script for automations.
* Strong understanding of structured data models.
* Basic SQL (preferred, but not mandatory).
* Knowledge of data visualisation principles.

Analytical Skills

* Ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and generate actionable insights.
* Strong numerical and problem-solving abilities.
* Experience working with multiple data sources and merging them into unified datasets.

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* High attention to detail and strong documentation discipline.
* Process-driven, organised, and proactive in identifying improvements.

What This Role Offers

* Opportunity to own Skyla’s entire data ecosystem.
* Exposure to cross-functional operations across 7+ properties.
* Hands-on experience with building end-to-end dashboards from scratch.
* Ability to implement automations that directly impact efficiency and leadership decisionmaking.
* Fast learning environment with significant autonomy.

Ideal Candidate Profile

* 2–5 years experience in analytics, reporting, or business intelligence.
* Hands-on experience with Google Sheets, Looker Studio, and data automation.
* Comfortable working with large datasets and building dashboards for senior management.
* A strong sense of ownership and willingness to experiment, learn, and innovate.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Business Analyst - CPQ
jobs.description:
**About the job**

**Job Title: Business Analyst, CPQ**

**Experience: 7 –9 Years**

**Employment Type:**
Permanent | Full-Time

**Shift & Hours:**
Regular Shift

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role Overview:**

* We run the Configure-Price-Quote (CPQ) platform for a global enterprise client on Salesforce Sales Cloud and Conga CPQ, with Conga Revenue Lifecycle Management (RLM) being adopted alongside it. The platform lives in a large, shared, multi-domain Salesforce org that serves many business units with a high-volume product catalog. Our mandate is to onboard a long pipeline of commercial offerings, each with its own catalog, pricing, rules, approvals and document templates. The application is documented in a structured knowledge base, so new team members learn from feature pages and process journeys rather than from tribal memory.

**The role**

* You own the functional definition of every offering we onboard. You take a product or pricing owner's description of how they sell, translate it into CPQ constructs, write stories a developer or configurator can execute without coming back to you, and prove the result works with the business in UAT. Conga experience is not required to start. Prior delivery on a CPQ platform is, together with the ability to learn a new one quickly from documentation and configuration data.

**What you will do**

* Run offering intake workshops with commercial, pricing, legal and finance owners and capture the as-is selling process, pricing model and approval paths.
* Model each offering into CPQ terms: product hierarchy, bundles and options, attributes, price lists and price list items, pricing and constraint rules, approval rules, quote and agreement templates.
* Write user stories with testable acceptance criteria, including data readiness, migration and rollback notes.
* Analyze existing configuration and data (price lists, rules, templates, field usage) to find reuse before anything new is created.
* Prepare UAT scenarios and test data, run UAT sessions, triage defects and separate configuration gaps from real bugs.
* Keep the feature documentation of every touched area current as part of each story's definition of done.
* Work daily with the technical lead, CPQ configurators, data engineer and QA, and represent the business view in design reviews.

**Must have:**

* 7+ years as a business analyst or functional consultant on enterprise applications, 3+ of them on any CPQ platform: Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Industries (Vlocity) CPQ, Oracle CPQ, SAP CPQ, PROS, Zilliant, DealHub, Zuora or Apttus/Conga.
* Working knowledge of quote-to-cash: catalog structure, bundles, attribute-based configuration, list and tiered pricing, discounting, approval matrices, contract generation.
* Proven ability to read configuration data and write precise, unambiguous requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Comfortable with data: advanced Excel, and SOQL or SQL for your own analysis.
* Agile delivery tooling (Jira, Azure DevOps or similar) and documentation tooling (Confluence or similar); strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder management in English.
* Salesforce platform literacy at Administrator level: objects, fields, record types, flows, permission sets.

**Good to have:**

* Conga CPQ or Conga RLM exposure.
* Document generation tools in the Salesforce ecosystem (Conga Composer, DocuSign Gen, Nintex or similar).
* Configuration data migration between orgs (Prodly, Data Loader, scripted loads or similar).
* Salesforce Administrator or Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification.
* Pricing experience in services, subscription or project-based businesses.
* If your CPQ experience is on another platform.

The Product Operations team plays a critical role in delivering Cisco’s next-generation hardware products on a scale. With a strong focus on reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence, the team drives impact across global operations and enables successful product outcomes.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
The Cisco Product Operations team is seeking a seasoned Product Lifecycle Program Manager (PLPM) to provide strategic leadership over global cost management and the end-to-end product lifecycle from inception to End-of-Life (EOL). This is a high-visibility, senior-level role that requires the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders—including Manufacturing, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Leadership—to align on strategy and execution for a portfolio of complex product solutions. You will be responsible for defining and implementing the frameworks that ensure operational efficiency and market competitiveness across our global manufacturing footprint.

* Strategic Cost Management& Lifecycle Oversight: Serve as the primary architect for end-to-end product lifecycle strategy, driving rigorous cost management protocols from launch through EOL to ensure sustained profitability.
* Engineering Change Governance: Provide authoritative oversight for Engineering Change Management, ensuring seamless technical transitions and minimal operational disruption.
* Product Quality& Financial Stewardship: Maintain stringent control over product quality benchmarks and cost structures, ensuring alignment with organizational financial targets.
* Complex Problem Resolution: Lead the mitigation of critical sustaining issues, including line-stop resolutions, CAP account management, AVL optimization, and continuous manufacturing process improvement.
* EOL Strategy& Orchestration: Direct the development and execution of holistic EOL strategies, partnering with integrated product teams to ensure smooth sunsetting of legacy solutions.

jobs.description:
Meet the Team
  
The Product Operations team plays a critical role in delivering Cisco’s next-generation hardware products on a scale. Working at the intersection of engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing, the team ensures seamless product lifecycle execution—from new product introduction to high-volume production and customer delivery. With a strong focus on reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence, the team drives impact across global operations and enables successful product outcomes.
  
Your Impact
  
The Cisco Product Operations team is seeking a Product Lifecycle Program Manager (PLPM) to manage global cost management and the end-to-end product lifecycle from inception to End-of-Life (EOL). This is a role that requires the ability to work cross-functionally with stakeholders—including Manufacturing, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Leadership—to align on strategy and execution for a portfolio of complex product solutions. You will be responsible for defining and implementing the frameworks that ensure operational efficiency and market competitiveness across our global manufacturing footprint.

* Product Quality& Financial Stewardship: Maintain stringent control over product quality benchmarks and cost structures, ensuring alignment with organizational financial targets.

* Knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) processes.

**Company Description**

**Eurofins Scientific** is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Industry: Technology, Information and Internet  
Company Name: Scaler AI Labs Inc

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

  

Min Experience: 4+ years  
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India  
JobType: full-time

We are looking for a skilled **Senior Backend Engineer** to design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and high-performance backend systems. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **Backend Engineering**, with experience building robust APIs, designing efficient databases, optimizing application performance, and developing secure, maintainable services.

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including frontend engineers, product managers, DevOps engineers, and data teams, to deliver high-quality software solutions. You will take ownership of backend architecture, technical implementation, and system reliability while contributing to engineering best practices and long-term technology strategy.

Candidates with additional experience in **Distributed Systems, Data Engineering, and Platform Engineering** will be preferred, particularly those who have worked on large-scale applications, cloud-native infrastructure, and complex data-intensive systems.

**Requirements**
----------------

Key Responsibilities

### **1. Backend Development and Architecture**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend applications and services.
* Build secure, reliable, and high-performance RESTful APIs and, where appropriate, GraphQL services.
* Develop modular, maintainable, and reusable code following established software engineering principles.
* Make architectural decisions that support scalability, reliability, and long-term product growth.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, production issues, and technical debt.

### **2. Database Management and Optimization**

* Design and optimize database schemas, queries, indexes, and data access patterns.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases to support application requirements.
* Ensure data integrity, consistency, availability, and efficient storage.
* Implement caching strategies and other performance optimization techniques.

### **3. System Reliability and Scalability**

* Develop backend systems capable of handling increasing traffic and growing data volumes.
* Implement monitoring, logging, error handling, and fault-tolerance mechanisms.
* Participate in code reviews, automated testing, debugging, and production deployments.
* Collaborate with DevOps and infrastructure teams to improve deployment workflows and system observability.

### **4. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with product and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to coding standards, documentation, and engineering practices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to existing systems.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* **Must-have:** Strong experience in Backend Engineering, including application development, API design, system architecture, and performance optimization.
* Proficiency in one or more backend programming languages, such as Python, Java, Go, Node.js, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and software design principles.
* Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, caching systems, and API integrations.
* Familiarity with version control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and production debugging.
* Understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices.

Good-to-Have Skills

* **Distributed Systems:** Experience with microservices, message queues, event-driven architectures, concurrency, and fault-tolerant systems.
* **Data Engineering:** Familiarity with data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, streaming systems, and large-scale data processing.
* **Platform Engineering:** Experience with cloud platforms, containerization, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, and developer platforms.
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform is an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with strong analytical skills, sound engineering judgment, and a commitment to building dependable software. They should be comfortable taking ownership of complex technical challenges, collaborating across teams, and improving system performance, scalability, and maintainability.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Technology Performance Manager
jobs.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

  

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**

  

The Technology Performance Manager operates the DPTF performance framework, defining and maintaining the delivery, service and technology metrics through which the function measures how well it runs. The role measures delivery against commitments, tracks service performance, availability and SLA attainment, and produces the executive performance reporting on which leadership relies. Its scope is how the technology estate and its delivery are performing, distinct from whether investments have returned their expected benefit.

  
  

Improvement against the metrics is owned in the platform and product domains. This role makes performance visible, identifies trends, risks and improvement opportunities, and coaches and challenges domain leadership against the commitments they have made. It works with the Strategic Supplier Manager where services span internal teams and partner-delivered capability, and with the Portfolio Value Realisation Manager so that performance and value are read together.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define and maintain the delivery, service and technology metric set for DPTF within the performance framework, ensuring metrics measure outcomes rather than activity, with agile maturity and flow measurement owned by the Senior Principal, Agile CoE as instruments of delivery method.
* Measure delivery performance against committed scope, dates and OKRs, making variance visible at both domain and function level.
* Track service reliability, availability and experience using SLOs, error budgets and flow metrics across the technology estate, including services delivered by partners.
* Produce the executive performance reporting pack for DPTF leadership, presenting a consistent and evidenced view of how the function and its domains are performing.
* Identify performance trends, emerging risks and improvement opportunities, and bring them to the domains and to governance with supporting evidence.
* Coach and challenge platform and domain leadership on performance, and own performance-improvement plans to closure where a metric breaches threshold, escalating to governance where improvement stalls, with delivery of actions in the domains.
* Work with the Strategic Supplier Manager to assess end-to-end performance where delivery and service span internal teams and supplier-provided capability.
* Ensure performance data is complete, accurate and comparable across domains, setting the measurement standards that federated Domain Portfolio Managers and platform teams apply.
* Build and maintain performance dashboards, so leadership can self-serve current performance information.
* Partner with the Portfolio Value Realisation Manager so that delivery and service performance is read alongside benefit realisation, not separately from it.
* Use AI and analytics to automate performance data collection, trend detection and reporting, reducing manual reporting effort.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the performance framework, including metric definitions, reporting standards and data quality expectations.
  

  

**Experience Required**

  

* Overall 15+ years of exp, typically 6-8 years in technology performance management, service management, delivery assurance, or technology reporting and analytics roles.
* Experience defining metric sets and KPIs for a large technology function, covering delivery, service and availability measures.
* Experience tracking SLA attainment and service performance across both internally and externally delivered services.
* Proven ability to produce executive-level performance reporting that leadership acts on.
* Experience identifying performance trends and risks from data and presenting them credibly to senior stakeholders.
* Experience working across a federated organisation to achieve consistent and comparable performance data.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards and reporting on enterprise reporting and analytics platforms, and familiarity with AI-enabled analytics applied to trend detection and reporting.
  

  

**Skills/Background**

  

* Strong analytical and data skills, able to turn large volumes of performance data into a clear and defensible picture.
* Excellent communication skills, able to present performance findings, including poor performance, factually and without apportioning blame.
* Discipline in data quality and attention to detail, since the credibility of reporting depends on it.
* Ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Well organised, able to run recurring reporting cycles reliably to deadline.
  

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Analytics, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Delivery Assurance, Design Thinking, DevOps, IT Performance Management, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Services Management, Software Development, Strategy Deployment, Technical Reporting, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Assistant Director – Product Manager, Conversational Artificial Intelligence**

**Purpose of the role:**

The role will own the product roadmap for conversational People Insights experiences, helping users access trusted workforce information through intuitive, natural-language interactions. It will focus on product discovery, prioritisation, delivery, adoption, governance and continuous improvement.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own the product roadmap, priorities and measurable outcomes for conversational People Insights products.
* Identify and validate priority workforce questions through user research, feedback, behavioural insights and experimentation.
* Translate user needs into clear product requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria and outcome measures.
* Prioritise features and improvements based on user value, evidence, delivery effort, risk and strategic importance.

**Description**
Join Amazon Health Services' One Medical team and shape the systems that determine how customer generated health data and third party health data drive better health outcomes for patients. You will define product strategy and drive execution for the platforms that ingest, normalize, and surface health data from diverse sources — wearables, connected devices, lab integrations, and patient reported inputs — turning fragmented signals into actionable clinical and consumer insights. These systems power experiences across the care continuum: enabling providers to make more informed decisions, helping patients engage meaningfully with their own health, and unlocking data driven personalization across Amazon Health Services.
  
  
Health data is unlike typical consumer data: it is governed by HIPAA and evolving state level privacy regulations, arrives in inconsistent formats (HL7, FHIR, proprietary device APIs), carries clinical significance that demands accuracy, and requires careful consent and access controls. Every product decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how One Medical ingests, reconciles, and leverages customer generated and third party health data to improve care delivery and patient outcomes. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across data ingestion pipelines, health record enrichment, data quality and normalization, and surfacing insights to clinicians and patients — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying data platforms and ML systems.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Define the product vision and multi year roadmap for customer generated health data systems: data ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and clinical surfacing
  
  
Translate complex health data and regulatory constraints (HIPAA, FHIR/HL7 interoperability, consent management, state privacy laws) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against
  
  
Design and own the end to end metrics framework for data quality, completeness, and clinical utility within your domain
  
  
Work with Clinical Operations, Provider Experience, Compliance, Privacy, and Platform Engineering partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
  
  
Partner with Applied Scientists and Engineers to define success criteria for data reconciliation models, insight generation algorithms, and automated triage systems
  
  
Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare
* Experience with ML/AI product management — defining success criteria for models, managing model lifecycle, A/B testing ML systems

jobs.title: Product Manager I
jobs.description:
**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager I who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.

**What You Will Need**

* Overall experience of 3+ yrs with at least 1+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred).
* Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking.
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development.

jobs.description:
Product · Bengaluru

You make *The Ken’s* corporate subscription a product that companies want, that their employees use, and that gets better every quarter.

Bengaluru; full-time; 2 to 4 years of experience.

  

Link Copied

  

### **About the role**

Companies already buy *The Ken* for their people. Corporate subscriptions are a significant percentage of our subscription revenue and one of the fastest-growing parts of it.

We want a corporate product that companies large and small find compelling enough to buy on their own, through the self-serve path we’ve had since 2018, without needing to be sold to. Something a 24-year-old analyst, a 34-year-old manager, and a 48-year-old business head can each use, even if what they take from it differs. Something that bundles in what we already do well beyond the daily story, such as workshops, talks, and live events, so they become part of an annual relationship rather than one-off revenue. Something that is visibly used, so that renewal is the default.

This role owns that product.

### **What you will do**

**Own the corporate product.** Define what a corporate subscription includes, for whom, at what tiers, and why. Write it down, ship it, keep changing it as you learn.

**Design for three kinds of employee.** Work out what early-career, mid-level, and senior people each need from *The Ken* and build the experiences that serve them: onboarding paths, briefings, formats, cohorts. One login for everyone is the starting point, not the product.

**Package what we already make.** Turn workshops, talks, live events, podcasts, and newsletters into things a corporate customer gets as part of the subscription. Decide what’s included, what’s an add-on, and what we stop.

**Own onboarding, activation, and engagement.** The product is only as good as the share of seats that get used. Build the onboarding flow, the activation nudges, and the account-level engagement view, and make seat usage a number everyone can see.

**Make the self-serve path work for companies.** A company should be able to discover, evaluate, buy, and expand without a call, and the buyer’s experience (admin, billing, seat management, reporting) should be as good as the reader’s.

**Define the measurement, then decide by it.** We don’t have account-level or seat-level measurement today. Define what it should count (seats active, engagement by segment, renewal, and expansion) and get it built. Know which packages activate, which features drive renewal, and where companies drop off. Kill what isn’t working.

**Talk to customers constantly.** HR and L&D buyers, the business heads who sponsor a subscription, the employees who use it or don’t. Bring what you hear into the product every month.

**Feed the people who sell.** Give them a product that’s easy to explain, obviously different, and backed by usage data that makes the renewal conversation short.

**Hold the line with the newsroom.** Many corporate customers are companies we’ve reported on critically, and they still buy. That’s the point. Exclusive features for corporates mean access, format, convenience, and curation. We never soften coverage. You keep that clear.

### **What we are looking for**

2 to 4 years in product management, growth, or a product-adjacent role at a subscription or B2B software business, ideally one where companies could buy without a salesperson. We care more about what you’ve owned and what happened to its numbers than where you worked.

You will do well here if:

– You’ve owned something end to end and can show what its numbers did while you had it.
  
– You’ve talked to enough customers to have been surprised by them.
  
– You like working out what different people need from the same product, and you’re happy building for a 24-year-old and a 48-year-old at once.
  
– You can build and read a funnel, a cohort view, and a renewal forecast, and present them to the founders monthly.
  
– You’ve killed something you built because the data said so.
  
– You can work across software, content, events, and people in the same week: an onboarding email, a workshop, a per-seat pricing argument.
  
– You read *The Ken* or something like it, and you’d rather sell a hard product honestly than an easy one loosely.
  
– Bonus: experience with L&D buyers, with packaging events or workshops into a subscription, or with seat-based pricing and activation metrics.

### **What you get**

A product of your own, with revenue attached, in a company small enough that your decisions ship. A customer base that already buys and renews, and that nobody has yet built a real product for. Resources in place: self-serve rails, a product and design team, events and workshops to bundle. And, over a year, the experience most product people at 2 to 4 years never get: owning a line from packaging to renewal, with the numbers to prove it.

Have questions?
  
Mail us at careers@the-ken.com with the name of the position in the subject line.

jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**




Join Novonesis as an SAP Basis Specialist and help ensure the reliability of the SAP platforms that support our ability to produce and distribute our products. You will become part of an experienced five-person SAP Basis team responsible for two legacy SAP platforms as well as the SAP infrastructure and Basis workstream for our SAP S/4HANA project.

The role & your impact

In this role, your primary focus will be operational reliability across our SAP landscape. Alongside day-to-day execution, you will help optimize how we operate through automation, improved monitoring, standardization and lifecycle management. You will also contribute to our SAP S/4HANA project and help establish the future operations and maintenance model.

Your key responsibilities in this role

Ensure SAP system availability, stability and performance by administering SAP RISE Private Cloud environments, monitoring system health, managing capacity and resolving incidents and technical problems.

Manage the technical lifecycle of SAP systems, including configuration, kernel updates, support packages, SAP Notes, upgrades, system copies, refreshes, migrations and technical conversions across environments.

Coordinate SAP RISE services and operational dependencies, acting as a technical interface between Novonesis, SAP, internal IT teams, application owners and external partners.

Maintain SAP security, compliance and controlled change management through secure technical configurations, user and certificate administration, vulnerability remediation, documented changes and reliable transport and release processes.

What you'll need to be successful in this role

  

Solid hands-on experience with SAP Basis and SAP HANA.

Experience managing incidents, service requests, maintenance activities and operational dependencies in collaboration with SAP.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities to identify root causes and resolve complex SAP Basis, HANA, performance, connectivity and cloud-related issues.

A structured approach to operational reliability, with the ability to prioritize, take ownership and collaborate effectively with internal teams, business stakeholders and external partners.

  
  

Additional skills & interests we value

  

An interest in continuously improving monitoring, documentation, standardization and operational processes.

A drive to identify repetitive activities that can be automated and establish reliable, repeatable ways of working.

Interest in cloud-based operating practices, scripting, automation and improved tooling.

  
  

What we offer you

An opportunity to join an experienced SAP Basis team responsible for business-critical SAP platforms and contribute directly to the SAP S/4HANA project. You will work across SAP, internal IT teams, functional teams, developers, integration specialists, application owners and business stakeholders while helping shape our future SAP operations and maintenance model.

This position is based in Bangalore and follows a hybrid working model. Standard working hours apply, with occasional travel.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Full Stack_AI-Native Application Developer.
jobs.description:
**A Snapshot of your Day**

We're looking for someone who builds and ships internal, production-grade web applications end-to-end — from a business problem to a live URL people use daily — by directing AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) rather than hand-writing every line.

This isn't "prompt and hope": it's owning the full lifecycle — architecture calls, integration debugging, production incidents, and the judgment to know when the AI's output needs to be checked rather than trusted.

You'll work largely solo, moving fast between ideas, working prototype, and production deployment, while integrating with real enterprise systems (SSO, mailboxes, databases, cloud infrastructure) that don't forgive sloppy assumptions.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Take a business need directly from a stakeholder (a team lead, an exec, a support team) and turn it into a working Next.js/React app without a formal spec or a dedicated developer team.
* Direct AI coding agents build features, then verify their output against how the system actually behaves — not just whether it compiles.
* Integrate with enterprise identity and data systems: SSO (Cognito + Entra), Microsoft Graph (mailbox/calendar access), shared internal database APIs, cloud AI services (AWS Bedrock)
* Own deployment: CI/CD pipelines, containerized deploys, environment configuration — enough infra literacy to read a failed pipeline and fix it yourself
* Debug production issues by building your own diagnostics (an admin page, a probe endpoint) rather than waiting on someone else's logs
* Recognize the boundary between "I can fix this myself" and "this needs IT/platform team” and write a clear, specific ask when it's the later, instead of thrashing on a workaround
* Test in production and iterate from real usage rather than over-planning up front
* Keep documentation current enough that the next person (or the next AI session) doesn't have to rediscover what you already figured out

**What You Bring**

**Technical**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Robotics, or a related field with minimum 5-6 years of relative experience
* Full-stack web development: React/Next.js, TypeScript, REST APIs
* Cloud fundamentals: AWS IAM, ECS/containers, CloudFormation basics — enough to reason about who owns what permission
* Enterprise auth: OAuth/OIDC, SSO integration (Cognito, Entra ID)
* SQL / relational data modeling, working within a shared/managed database rather than standing up your own
* Git/GitLab, CI/CD pipeline literacy

AI-assisted development ("vibe coding") specifically

* Fluency directing AI coding agents to build real, deployed software — not just toy scripts
* The judgment to catch when an AI's output is subtly wrong (e.g., an IAM policy written for the wrong model version) rather than shipping it as-is
* Comfortable debugging by reading actual system behavior (live API calls, logs, diagnostics) instead of guessing
* Knows the difference between a code problem and an infrastructure/permissions problem — and doesn't burn cycles trying to code around the latter

**Working style**

* Direct communicator — wants the one-sentence answer, not a hedge
* Ships fast, tests in prod, iterates from what breaks
* Comfortable being both the builder and the product owner for what you ship
* Persistent through ambiguous, multi-day infrastructure blockers without losing momentum on everything else

**Nice to have**

* Design-system awareness (brand consistency, accessibility)
* Experience building analytics/reporting features (charting, data taxonomies, dedup pipelines)
* Comfort coordinating directly with IT/platform teams on access and permissions requests
* Candidate will be required to work with USA team and should be comfortable working on US time zones

customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.

* Act as the main mobile product point of contact for one or more airline clients throughout the engagement lifecycle.
* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with client product, commercial, digital, and operations stakeholders.
* Run discovery workshops to understand each airline's mobile experience objectives, passenger journey goals, and operational constraints.
* Manage client expectations on mobile app scope, timelines, and trade-offs; communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly.

Requirements & Mobile Backlog Ownership

* Capture, analyze, and translate client requirements into clear mobile app user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria.
* Own and prioritize the client-specific mobile product backlog, balancing client requests against platform capabilities and the broader mobile roadmap.
* Distinguish between standard/configurable mobile features and custom development, advising clients on the most efficient path.
* Make data-informed trade-off decisions and negotiate mobile feature priorities with clients when demand exceeds capacity.

Mobile Solution Delivery & Configuration

* Guide clients through configuration of core mobile app capabilities: flight search & booking, check-in, boarding passes, seat selection, baggage, flight status, push notifications, and disruption handling.
* Oversee branding, localization, and client-specific business rules within the mobile application.
* Coordinate integration of the mobile app with the airline's systems (PSS/GDS, loyalty, payment gateways, operational data feeds).
* Support ancillary and loyalty feature enablement on mobile to drive client revenue.

Cross-Functional Coordination (Internal)

* Bridge client needs and internal Agile mobile delivery teams; lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and mobile app demos.
* Collaborate with mobile UX/UI, engineering, QA, and delivery/project managers to ensure committed features are delivered to quality.
* Channel recurring or high-value client requests into the core mobile product roadmap as candidate platform features.

Mobile Adoption, Value & Continuous Improvement

* Define mobile success metrics with each client (app adoption, conversion, ancillary attach rate, NPS/CSAT, app store rating).
* Use mobile analytics and client feedback to recommend enhancements and demonstrate value realization.
* Conduct post-release reviews and mobile roadmap planning sessions with clients.

Governance, Compliance & Quality

* Ensure delivered mobile solutions meet aviation regulations, accessibility (WCAG), data privacy (GDPR/PCI-DSS), and app store guidelines.
* Maintain clear documentation of mobile app client commitments, decisions, and configuration choices.
