**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's operations network (Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres) is the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. It moves billions of units of inventory, employs tens of thousands of people, and makes sure customers get what they want when promised. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 pilots and proves new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, before they scale across this network.  
  
The Innovation Lab is looking for a passionate, results-oriented Business Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. The selected candidate will build and maintain the data platform, tools and reporting that tell us whether each pilot is working. They will also dig into the data to find the root cause of defects and give the team the evidence it needs to decide which solutions scale. The BA will also support hands-on pilot execution on the floor when required.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Build the data foundation for every trial: write the SQL queries and extracts that pull pilot data from operational systems
* Design and maintain dashboards that show each trial's progress against its success criteria
* Set up alerts and exception reports that flag when a trial metric moves off target, so the team can act the same day
* Monitor the health of DWP jobs, dashboards and data sources, and keep them reliable (target: 100% availability)
* Find and fix the root cause of data issues and trouble tickets (failed jobs, missing or mismatched data)
* Define the data plan for each pilot (metrics, baseline, collection method) before the trial starts
* Own the lab scorecard and daily pilot report, and prepare the data for weekly business reviews and leadership updates
* Analyse dashboard and alert trends to find the root cause of defects and underperformance, and propose specific actions
* Support site-readiness analysis when a solution moves to a new site
* Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan
* Collect physical data (time studies, downtime and fault logs) and keep the issue log up to date
* Follow and enforce pilot-area safety controls, including pre-trial checks for automation zones

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of data analytics or automation experience
* 1+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
* Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

**Job Description:**

Microchip Technology is seeking a **Senior Data Analyst** in our Bengaluru office to join the Corporate Marketing organization. The Senior Data Analyst will develop and execute marketing analytics strategies that provide stakeholders across Marketing and Microchip with actionable, data-driven insights to support business decisions and optimize marketing performance.

This role will oversee the design, implementation, and governance of analytics solutions, including data management, reporting, dashboard development, and communicating insights. The Senior Data Analyst will be the senior member of a team responsible for building and maintaining ETL processes using Python and SQL to extract data from marketing platforms into enterprise data repositories and the presentation of data using Tableau and Adobe Analytics. This position reports to the Senior Manager, MarCom Analytics.

**Requirements/Qualifications:**

**Responsibilities**

  

* Define and execute the marketing analytics strategy, roadmap, and governance framework to support business objectives.
* Oversee the development, monitoring, and maintenance of scalable ETL pipelines and data infrastructure using Python.
* Direct the collection, transformation, validation, and integration of marketing data into enterprise SQL databases.
* Ensure the accuracy, reliability, security, and accessibility of marketing data across platforms and reporting solutions.
* Oversee the development and maintenance of Tableau dashboards, Adobe Analytics projects, and other reporting solutions that enable stakeholders to understand marketing performance and make informed business decisions.
* Partner with stakeholders across Marketing and the broader organization to define business requirements, establish KPIs, and deliver actionable insights.
* Prioritize and manage analytics projects, stakeholder requests, reporting initiatives, and resource allocation across the team.
* Present findings, recommendations, and performance trends to leadership and key stakeholders.
* Establish best practices, standards, and documentation for analytics, reporting, and data management processes.
* Drive adoption of analytics tools and data-driven decision-making through training, enablement, and organizational support.
* Lead efforts to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to data quality, ETL processes, databases, and Tableau dashboards.
* Evaluate and implement new technologies, data sources, and third-party API integrations to enhance marketing analytics capabilities and operational efficiency.

**Job Requirements**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Marketing Analytics, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, data management, or marketing analytics.
* Experience designing and overseeing ETL processes and managing large-scale data environments.
* Proficient with Python, SQL, and database management.
* Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools, such as Tableau and Adobe Analytics.
* Demonstrated ability to develop analytics strategies and translate business requirements into scalable reporting and measurement solutions.
* Stakeholder management skills with experience collaborating across marketing, sales, and IT teams.

**Travel Time:**

0% - 25%

Surya was founded in 1999 by Mr. D.N. Prahlad (an early employee of Infosys), to create software products. Headquartered in Bangalore, we also have offices in the USA, and France.
  
  
Surya Financial Technologies Private Limited (Surya), has been leading the Financial Control & Risk Management solution space with 25+ years of experience in developing and implementing Risk Management and Balance Sheet Management Solutions at 75+ BFSI customers globally. Surya has invested heavily in the research & development in the ever-evolving Financial Risk landscape and has been at the forefront of providing solutions that not just meet the guidelines and requirements for today but also supporting the institutions with future ready investments.
  
  
Surya, being a global player, has a strong clientele spreading across South Asia, Middle East, Africa and North America. In the span of 25+ years, Surya has addressed and successfully implemented Financial Risk Transformation projects, working with marquee clients with an Asset Base of USD 450 Bn+ to less than USD 500 Mn, across the spectrum of financial services industry.
  
  
At Surya, we believe that high quality leads to high productivity. We offer the right balance of technical excellence in software engineering and deep knowledge of risk management. Our core values are focused on simplicity, superior functional architecture, advanced technology, quick deployment, and ease of maintenance. We ensure high levels of efficiency and lower total cost of ownership (TCO) for our clients. We understand that an organization’s risk and reporting requirements are growing more sophisticated every year with evolving and new regulations, expansion into new markets, and competitive pressures. Adopting Innovation in technology and coming up with world class solutions which can be deployed with ease has been the corner stone of Surya’s success globally.
  
  
**Your Growth at Surya**
Surya’s growth is driven by ordinary people who have extraordinary dreams and are bold enough to pursue them. Our leadership team, including our Managing Director, is composed primarily of people who joined Surya as freshers. Through our process of continuous feedback, and regular 1-1 conversations, we believe in upskilling our team, and enabling each of them to grow along paths they find satisfying.

* Drive post-implementation adoption by resolving functional issues, refining workflows, and ensuring effective utilization of GRC modules.
* Contribute to product enhancements by identifying gaps and incorporating implementation learnings into functional improvements.

* Configure and deploy GRC/ORMS platforms, including workflows, forms, rules, and role-based access controls.

* Collaborate with engineering teams to translate functional requirements into technical designs, APIs, and system integrations.

This customer segments not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health and life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit. While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need properguidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on-the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when comparedto upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t workfor this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.

We are looking for a seasoned Treasury Domain Business Analyst to lead requirements, solution design, and delivery support across Treasury functions including Liquidity, Cash & Funding, ALM/IRRBB, FTP, Collateral, and Treasury Reporting. The role will partner with Treasury stakeholders, Technology teams, and vendors to deliver regulatory-compliant, scalable, and auditable solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

1) Treasury Business Analysis & Solution Definition

· Lead end-to-end requirement elicitation (workshops, interviews, process walkthroughs).

· Translate business needs into BRD/FRD, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.

· Define target operating model (TOM) impacts and change requirements for Treasury processes.

· Own functional solution design covering process, data, controls, and reporting.

2) Treasury Functional Coverage (Core)

· Liquidity & cash management: cash positioning, forecasting, intraday liquidity, LCR/NSFR.

· ALM & interest rate risk: IRRBB, EVE/NII sensitivity, gap analysis, behavioral modeling inputs.

· Define data lineage across Treasury source systems (trades, GL, risk, market data).

· Drive control design: auditability, approvals, Maker-Checker, exception management.

· Support data quality initiatives: DQ rules, reconciliations, thresholds, root-cause analysis.

4) Delivery, Testing & Governance

· Support Agile/Hybrid delivery: backlog grooming, sprint planning, and stakeholder demos.

· Lead/assist SIT/UAT, scenario building, test execution, defect triage, and closure.

· Manage RAID, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication across business/IT.

· Ensure documentation completeness: SOPs, training guides, runbooks, and support handover.

5) Stakeholder Management

· Act as a key interface between Treasury (business), Risk, Finance, Operations, and IT.
